## Brand & Style

This design system expresses a tactile, literary sanctuary rooted in the pine-scented mist of Landour. The aesthetic synthesizes high-Victorian colonial library restraint—distinguished wainscoting, letterpress ink, antique brass joinery—with rugged Garhwali dry-stone masonry and raw deodar cedarwood craft. 

The emotional tone evokes quiet nostalgia, slow contemplation, steam rising from spiced mountain tea, and the distinct optical phenomenon of the Himalayan winter line. It rejects sterile Silicon Valley minimalism in favor of an artisanal editorial character: deckled edges, bookbinding rules, intimate margins, deliberate warm paper backgrounds, and atmospheric dusk-inspired chromatic accents.

## Colors

The palette draws directly from the Garhwal ridge line and vintage naturalist field guides:

- **Primary (`#2A4736` — Deodar Pine):** A deep, resinous conifer green anchoring focal actions, structural framing, and primary visual emphasis.
- **Secondary (`#C5A059` — Antique Himalayan Brass):** Weathered metallic warmth, used for ornamental accents, metadata tags, crest dividers, and fine status indicators.
- **Tertiary (`#A63A38` — Wild Rhododendron):** A sun-warmed, botanical crimson evoking spring hillside blooms, used for secondary callouts, seasonal specials, alerts, and subtle hover states.
- **Neutral Canvas (`#FAF7F2` — Sun-Bleached Parchment):** The luminous base layer reminiscent of rag paper and aged manuscript leaves, paired with `#F5EFEB` for secondary panel depths.
- **Slate Accent (`#5C768D` — Mountain Mist Slate):** Used for atmospheric sub-text, secondary chips, and quiet geological balance.
- **Ink / Typography (`#2C1D11` & `#3E2723` — Roasted Espresso & Iron Gall Ink):** Replaces clinical carbon blacks with deep roasted undertones that simulate antique letterpress on cotton paper.

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy embraces literary publishing craftsmanship:

- **EB Garamond** anchors all editorial headers and atmospheric storytelling. Its historic proportions, graceful ascenders, and italic swashes echo vintage Himalayan memoirs and antique poetry journals.
- **Literata** handles continuous narrative prose, tasting descriptions, and menu profiles. Originally designed for prolonged digital book reading, its warm organic terminals ensure legibility over creamy backdrops without digital glare.
- **Hanken Grotesk** serves purely utilitarian roles—metadata, timestamps, altitude coordinates, pricing, and button labels. Set in small, tracked-out upper or medium weights, it provides structured counterpoint to the romantic serifs without breaking the antique ambiance.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a centered, bounded grid structure inspired by traditional book design, avoiding edge-to-edge hyper-widescreen spreads.

- **Desktop Layout:** 12-column grid capped at `1200px` max-width. Columns use generous `2.5rem` (`40px`) gutters and `4rem` outer screen margins. Long-form reading views restrict body copy to an intimate 8-column or 720px optimal reading measure.
- **Tablet Layout (768px - 1024px):** 8-column layout with `1.5rem` gutters and `2.5rem` side margins. Multi-column cards collapse gracefully into double-column pairings.
- **Mobile Layout (<768px):** 4-column layout with `1rem` gutters and `1.25rem` margins. Menus and literary narratives use single-column flows punctuated by horizontal rule ornaments.
- **Rhythm:** Generous vertical breathing room (`space-3xl` to `space-4xl` between thematic chapters) evokes unhurried contemplation.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects harsh digital drop-shadows. Instead, elevation is expressed through paper layering, warm ambient diffused occlusion, and low-contrast rules:

- **Surface Tiers:**
  - **Base Canvas:** `#FAF7F2` (Parchment white).
  - **Elevated Card Surface:** `#F5EFEB` (Milled hand-pressed paper).
  - **Sunken Well / Inset:** `#EDE5D8` (Pressed leather / binding groove).
- **Shadow Quality:** Shadows represent soft daylight filtered through deodar needles or warm indoor hurricane lamps.
  - **Low Lift (Cards, Dropdowns):** `0 4px 16px -2px rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.04)`.
  - **Floating Focus (Modals, Overlays):** `0 16px 36px -4px rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.12), 0 4px 8px rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.06)`.
- **Ornamental Framing:** High-priority containers incorporate a 1px inner hairline border in `#C5A059` (Brass, 25% opacity) or `#3E2723` (Ink, 12% opacity) to evoke bookbinder gilding.

## Shapes

The shape system employs soft, restrained corners (`0.25rem` / `4px` baseline) reflecting hand-cut paper stock, beveled cedar planks, and bound bookboards rather than slick consumer software curves.

- **Base Radius:** `4px` for buttons, text inputs, small badges, and tooltips.
- **Card & Frame Radius:** `6px` to `8px` for larger structural containers, maintaining a grounded, architectural posture.
- **Pills / Circles:** Strictly reserved for round stamp insignias, botanical crests, and circular author portraits.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Background in `#2A4736` (Deodar Green) with `#FAF7F2` text, set in `label-lg` uppercase Hanken Grotesk. Hover subtly shifts to a deeper moss tone with a fine 1px brass glow outline (`rgba(197, 160, 89, 0.4)`).
- **Secondary / Antique:** Background transparent, 1px solid border in `#C5A059` (Brushed Brass) with `#2C1D11` text. Hover fills with `#C5A059` at 10% opacity.
- **Tertiary / Literary Link:** Understated text button in `#A63A38` (Rhododendron) with an offset, hand-drawn-style hairline underline (`text-underline-offset: 6px`).

### Chips & Badges
- Compact tags with a `4px` corner radius.
- Background in `#F5EFEB` with a 1px border in `#5C768D` (Slate Mist, 25% opacity).
- Type set in `label-sm` with letter spacing `0.1em`. Used for altitude markers (`"Alt. 7,120 ft"`), harvest notes, and culinary provenance.

### Input Fields
- Resting state features `#FAF7F2` fill, a 1px bottom or framed border in `#2C1D11` (20% opacity), and placeholder text in `#5C768D`.
- Focus state shifts border to `#2A4736` or `#C5A059` with a gentle 2px ambient tint, accompanied by literary serif labels placed above the input.

### Cards & Menu Folios
- Built on `#F5EFEB` textured panels with `1px solid rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.08)`.
- Header section features an optional delicate double-hairline book divider in `#C5A059`.
- Culinary & beverage cards display the dish name in `headline-sm` EB Garamond, an editorial story description in `body-sm` Literata, and price aligned right in `label-lg` Hanken Grotesk.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Square with a tight 2px radius or classic concentric circles.
- Unchecked: `#FAF7F2` background with a 1.5px `#2C1D11` (30% opacity) border.
- Checked: `#2A4736` fill with an antique brass `#C5A059` check or inner pip.

### Bespoke Domain Components
- **Winter Line Horizon Bar:** A specialized horizontal section divider featuring a low-opacity gradient mimicking Landour's dusk horizon (deep mauve to glowing amber ochre to night slate).
- **Bibliophile Marginalia / Footnotes:** Sidenote containers set in `title-editorial` (EB Garamond italic) with an antique brass vertical accent stroke, used for local folklore, Ruskin Bond quotations, and weather advisories.

## Brand & Style

This design system expresses a tactile, literary sanctuary rooted in the pine-scented mist of Landour. The aesthetic synthesizes high-Victorian colonial library restraint—distinguished wainscoting, letterpress ink, antique brass joinery—with rugged Garhwali dry-stone masonry and raw deodar cedarwood craft. 

The emotional tone evokes quiet nostalgia, slow contemplation, steam rising from spiced mountain tea, and the distinct optical phenomenon of the Himalayan winter line. It rejects sterile Silicon Valley minimalism in favor of an artisanal editorial character: deckled edges, bookbinding rules, intimate margins, deliberate warm paper backgrounds, and atmospheric dusk-inspired chromatic accents.

## Colors

The palette draws directly from the Garhwal ridge line and vintage naturalist field guides:

- **Primary (`#2A4736` — Deodar Pine):** A deep, resinous conifer green anchoring focal actions, structural framing, and primary visual emphasis.
- **Secondary (`#C5A059` — Antique Himalayan Brass):** Weathered metallic warmth, used for ornamental accents, metadata tags, crest dividers, and fine status indicators.
- **Tertiary (`#A63A38` — Wild Rhododendron):** A sun-warmed, botanical crimson evoking spring hillside blooms, used for secondary callouts, seasonal specials, alerts, and subtle hover states.
- **Neutral Canvas (`#FAF7F2` — Sun-Bleached Parchment):** The luminous base layer reminiscent of rag paper and aged manuscript leaves, paired with `#F5EFEB` for secondary panel depths.
- **Slate Accent (`#5C768D` — Mountain Mist Slate):** Used for atmospheric sub-text, secondary chips, and quiet geological balance.
- **Ink / Typography (`#2C1D11` & `#3E2723` — Roasted Espresso & Iron Gall Ink):** Replaces clinical carbon blacks with deep roasted undertones that simulate antique letterpress on cotton paper.

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy embraces literary publishing craftsmanship:

- **EB Garamond** anchors all editorial headers and atmospheric storytelling. Its historic proportions, graceful ascenders, and italic swashes echo vintage Himalayan memoirs and antique poetry journals.
- **Literata** handles continuous narrative prose, tasting descriptions, and menu profiles. Originally designed for prolonged digital book reading, its warm organic terminals ensure legibility over creamy backdrops without digital glare.
- **Hanken Grotesk** serves purely utilitarian roles—metadata, timestamps, altitude coordinates, pricing, and button labels. Set in small, tracked-out upper or medium weights, it provides structured counterpoint to the romantic serifs without breaking the antique ambiance.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a centered, bounded grid structure inspired by traditional book design, avoiding edge-to-edge hyper-widescreen spreads.

- **Desktop Layout:** 12-column grid capped at `1200px` max-width. Columns use generous `2.5rem` (`40px`) gutters and `4rem` outer screen margins. Long-form reading views restrict body copy to an intimate 8-column or 720px optimal reading measure.
- **Tablet Layout (768px - 1024px):** 8-column layout with `1.5rem` gutters and `2.5rem` side margins. Multi-column cards collapse gracefully into double-column pairings.
- **Mobile Layout (<768px):** 4-column layout with `1rem` gutters and `1.25rem` margins. Menus and literary narratives use single-column flows punctuated by horizontal rule ornaments.
- **Rhythm:** Generous vertical breathing room (`space-3xl` to `space-4xl` between thematic chapters) evokes unhurried contemplation.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects harsh digital drop-shadows. Instead, elevation is expressed through paper layering, warm ambient diffused occlusion, and low-contrast rules:

- **Surface Tiers:**
  - **Base Canvas:** `#FAF7F2` (Parchment white).
  - **Elevated Card Surface:** `#F5EFEB` (Milled hand-pressed paper).
  - **Sunken Well / Inset:** `#EDE5D8` (Pressed leather / binding groove).
- **Shadow Quality:** Shadows represent soft daylight filtered through deodar needles or warm indoor hurricane lamps.
  - **Low Lift (Cards, Dropdowns):** `0 4px 16px -2px rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.04)`.
  - **Floating Focus (Modals, Overlays):** `0 16px 36px -4px rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.12), 0 4px 8px rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.06)`.
- **Ornamental Framing:** High-priority containers incorporate a 1px inner hairline border in `#C5A059` (Brass, 25% opacity) or `#3E2723` (Ink, 12% opacity) to evoke bookbinder gilding.

## Shapes

The shape system employs soft, restrained corners (`0.25rem` / `4px` baseline) reflecting hand-cut paper stock, beveled cedar planks, and bound bookboards rather than slick consumer software curves.

- **Base Radius:** `4px` for buttons, text inputs, small badges, and tooltips.
- **Card & Frame Radius:** `6px` to `8px` for larger structural containers, maintaining a grounded, architectural posture.
- **Pills / Circles:** Strictly reserved for round stamp insignias, botanical crests, and circular author portraits.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Background in `#2A4736` (Deodar Green) with `#FAF7F2` text, set in `label-lg` uppercase Hanken Grotesk. Hover subtly shifts to a deeper moss tone with a fine 1px brass glow outline (`rgba(197, 160, 89, 0.4)`).
- **Secondary / Antique:** Background transparent, 1px solid border in `#C5A059` (Brushed Brass) with `#2C1D11` text. Hover fills with `#C5A059` at 10% opacity.
- **Tertiary / Literary Link:** Understated text button in `#A63A38` (Rhododendron) with an offset, hand-drawn-style hairline underline (`text-underline-offset: 6px`).

### Chips & Badges
- Compact tags with a `4px` corner radius.
- Background in `#F5EFEB` with a 1px border in `#5C768D` (Slate Mist, 25% opacity).
- Type set in `label-sm` with letter spacing `0.1em`. Used for altitude markers (`"Alt. 7,120 ft"`), harvest notes, and culinary provenance.

### Input Fields
- Resting state features `#FAF7F2` fill, a 1px bottom or framed border in `#2C1D11` (20% opacity), and placeholder text in `#5C768D`.
- Focus state shifts border to `#2A4736` or `#C5A059` with a gentle 2px ambient tint, accompanied by literary serif labels placed above the input.

### Cards & Menu Folios
- Built on `#F5EFEB` textured panels with `1px solid rgba(44, 29, 17, 0.08)`.
- Header section features an optional delicate double-hairline book divider in `#C5A059`.
- Culinary & beverage cards display the dish name in `headline-sm` EB Garamond, an editorial story description in `body-sm` Literata, and price aligned right in `label-lg` Hanken Grotesk.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Square with a tight 2px radius or classic concentric circles.
- Unchecked: `#FAF7F2` background with a 1.5px `#2C1D11` (30% opacity) border.
- Checked: `#2A4736` fill with an antique brass `#C5A059` check or inner pip.

### Bespoke Domain Components
- **Winter Line Horizon Bar:** A specialized horizontal section divider featuring a low-opacity gradient mimicking Landour's dusk horizon (deep mauve to glowing amber ochre to night slate).
- **Bibliophile Marginalia / Footnotes:** Sidenote containers set in `title-editorial` (EB Garamond italic) with an antique brass vertical accent stroke, used for local folklore, Ruskin Bond quotations, and weather advisories.
- **Wax Seal / Stamp Crest:** Circular graphic container with deckled perimeter styling used for certifying organic Himalayan single-origin ingredients.
